avk.jpg.giveaway: Reads as a real frame. Seven thin twisted/striped candles (red-white, blue-white, plain yellow) of uneven height and slight lean, each with a small sharp teardrop flame with a bright core and a faint halo. Hand-spread buttercream with an uneven piped rim of crumbs/sprinkles, irregular dark dots on the side, red piped characters (sheng ri kuai ...) that are legible and stroke-like. Soft lens falloff, background rim light band across the top, real compression blockiness rather than added noise. Cake top is lit from the candles themselves (warm pools around each wick).

gcv.jpg.giveaway: Reads as a real frame. Side-on view, cake on a dark board/plate on a square-edged table top that recedes into darkness; thin candles of varied heights with real small flames and a faint smoke wisp; frosting is uneven with dark polka-dot decorations and a lumpy piped top border; red lettering peeks over the rim. Light falls off naturally and the table edge is soft, not a hard band. Compression artefacts, not synthetic grain.

jyt.jpg.giveaway: Best of the renderings but still clearly CG. Flames are grey-white fuzzy balls (like cotton swabs or dandelion heads) with no bright yellow core and no light cast on the frosting near the wicks. Candles are thick, all the same height and spaced in a perfectly even straight row along the back rim; in the film they are thin, uneven, scattered over the top. Cake side is a uniform beige sponge texture with one faint seam line; no piping, no dots, no crumb border; vertical walls are perfectly straight cylinder. Table is a flat featureless orange plane with a circular spot vignette and a hard dark band along the bottom edge; no plate/board character. Grain is uniform overlay noise, evenly distributed in the black areas. Red lettering is an illegible smear.

kbp.jpg.giveaway: Same scene construction as jyt with worse artefacts: cake silhouette has doubled/ghosted edges (left and right side smear), candles clumped and overlapping, flames again grey puffballs. Cake reads as a pale fabric drum with horizontal smudge texture; board is a thin bright ellipse with a dark ring under the cake. Table is a flat orange disc of light with an artificial hard bottom edge. No real light emitted from candles onto the cake top.

alm.jpg.giveaway: Two-tier drum with a glowing gold ring at the seam and at the top rim, which looks like a lamp or tyre, not frosting. Cake is lit uniformly from the front and is darker than the table, inconsistent with candle light. Candles have ghost duplicates and smeared verticals; flames are grey fuzzy spheres. Cake board ellipse is too wide and too clean. Same flat orange table plane, circular vignette and hard black lower band.

uma.jpg.giveaway: Top-down three-quarter view with no table or plate visible: cake floats in black. Cake is far too tall relative to diameter and the side wall is a smeared, blurred bucket with a glowing edge halo. Candles are tiny stubs (about one-tenth of cake height) with no visible flames, arranged evenly round the rim. Top has a concentric swirl/ripple texture like a sponge or pie crust. Red lettering is the most legible of the renders but sits flat and evenly coloured, like a decal. Overall orange-saturated monochrome with no highlights or specular frosting.

gjf.jpg.giveaway: Cake body is almost black, so it reads as a dark cylinder silhouette rather than a cream cake; only the top rim catches light. Candles look like matchsticks or cotton buds with grey round heads. The board is a bright thin ellipse, and the table is a lit orange plane that is brighter than the cake, so the key light is obviously an overhead spot rather than the candles. Hard straight dark band along the bottom edge and uniform noise.

sda.jpg.giveaway: Floating cake with no table; oversized tall cylinder whose edges glow and smear like a bloom/ghost pass. Candles are short stubs with grey smoke-puff tips instead of flames; one candle is a pale translucent ghost. Red lettering is a blob. Concentric swirl texture on top, smeared fibrous texture on the side. Orange monochrome with no specular or shadow detail; base ring is a dark slab.

sfi.jpg.giveaway: Same floating top-down cake as sda/uma. Candles are tiny, wide-striped, unevenly lit; two have grey smoke puffs, one is a translucent ghost duplicate. Lettering is an illegible red smear. Top surface has a swirled, sandpaper texture with a bright inner ring like a pie crust. Edges of the cake bleed into a halo. Candle flames are small white dots with no glow on the surrounding frosting. Cake wall is too tall and too even.

wxr.jpg.giveaway: Weakest: candles clustered in the middle of the top with ghosted, transparent duplicates (one candle appears as a stack of faded copies), lettering is a smear, cake edges wobble and smear heavily (temporal blending), side texture is fibrous noise, no table or plate. Floating in pure black with uniform grain. Scale of candles to cake is wrong.
